name: page-canvas
title: Page Canvas
description: The presentation page shell: the page scrolls, content sits in a centered column, and a section can run edge to edge.
docs: Use for a screen presented to someone, under data-design="presentation". PageCanvas wraps the document; PageSection gives each block a centered column and generous vertical space, and variant="band" runs a raised surface edge to edge. Hierarchy comes from space and elevation. An operations screen uses AppShell instead. See DESIGN.md "Profiles".
